investigations.question: What happens past gate-open on x=12288-12400 and at collection, what kills the pilot at 7603/8770/9979, and what does each death cost in replay seconds? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input history, no position/tier trace, no hazard-phase data, and no gameplay frames; encounter causes, unfair hotspots, and policy defects are all live, and the unplayed crown approach may hold defects no finding yet names.
investigations.smallestNextStep: Bounded rerun that continues past gate-open to crown collection with death events (hazard id/cause/phase at each death), input history, a position/tier trace, checkpoint replay time, and retained gameplay frames of the crown approach including telegraph visibility in the frames before each death; repeat across fresh starts/phases. Only if a hotspot repeats in captured play may an encounter edit be proposed.

fixes.smallestFix: Add a checkpoint so no gap over 2500px is without one, clear of beam timing and patrol lanes.
fixes.recheck: Re-run the full critic: no checkpoint gap over 2500px may remain, and the rerun must retain checkpoint replay time after death in the repaired stretch showing a lower seconds-cost than the retained run.
fixes.limitations: Code-measured from checkpoint data, but replay time in seconds is not retained, so the seconds-cost of the gap is estimated from distance until INV-1 measures it; no retained death falls inside the gap, so the gap's cost rests on the rule measurement plus the later deaths' replay distances.
fixes.alternativeCause: Deliberate pacing: a long checkpoint-free stretch may be intended difficulty -- but 3300px exceeds the 2500px rule, so the build report would need to justify the exception, and none is on record.
